Duitara. 

Hadien ter ter lah ban tern pynmih sur na ka Duitara ha ka rukom sur tynrai (Traditional) sur 
paidbah (Popular tunes), sur kyllain (Semi Classical), Sur jyrthiaw (Classical) ba ka Duitara kaba 
long ka Syiem jong ki ‘Tiar jingtem Khasi” kan shongkhet ha ka rynsan ba dei biang. Nga da sngewdei 
hok ban ai khublei shikit iapar da shisha shisha ia ki baroh.

Ha ki Exercises ba la thoh ter ter ha kane ka kot jinghikai tern Duitara, man kawei pat kawei 
ka lynnong dei ban sdang ban tern nyngkong eh da kaba tern suki kat ban sngew ban biang ki 
shympriah kti ban buh halor ki ksai ka Duitara ba uwei pa uwei u Note un mih shai kdar ka sur kat 
banbiang sbiak sbiak. 

Nangta sa tern kham stet. Shuh shuh nang kham stet shuh shuh, shuh shuh nangtem kliiun stet. 
Shuh, shuh shuh nangtem stet shisha haduh ba ki shympriahkti kin da khih shaneng shanim kum ki 
shympriahkti ba par u dkhiew. 

Ban mang ia ka jingtem stet na kawei sha kawei pat ka jingkham stet ter ter, dci ban buh da 
thcw ia ka jingstet ba la buh ryntih ha u Metronome Settings la ha ka Largo, Larghetto, Adagio, 
Andante, Moderate, Allegro, Presto bad Prestissimo. 

Kajingpynmih iaki sur kyriiah kadei kajingpynmlien ban tern da kynthah la ki sympriahkti. 
Kajingpynmih ia ki sur ud ka wan mih na kajingpynmlien ban tern da syllud ia ki shympriahkti la 
shaneng ne sharum jong u ksai Duitara halor Jong uwei u note ban pynmih ka jingkynud ba iaibtcng ia 
uwei ne artylli ki sur bteng-kynud katba sngewmon ban pynmih ia ka sur ud. 

Naduh ka lynnong (Exercise) Part 11, bad ki lynnong ba bud ter ter la buh ban tern da kaba 
bynta ia ki notes ban tern ha ki pulses (ki tied) jong ki aih ba la buh da ka Tonic Solfa Notation. 
Namar kata ki nongtem ki dei ban nang ia ki rules (aih) jong ka Tonic Solfa Notation. Ban ioh bud 
pynsnah ia ka rukom tern sur khasi ha ka Tonic Solfa Notation, ka don sa kawei de ka kot jinghikai 
ba la thoh bad ba la pynmih madan kaba la ai kyrteng “Ka Persara ki Sur Khasi ha ka Tonic Solfa 
Notation.”
